## What changed

Invalid records (`Valid = false` — decoder parsed the shape but not the contents, e.g. a garbage value column) were flowing into every report answer. The pipeline's `filter` stage only drops them when `DropInvalid` is configured, so reporting couldn't rely on it. The fix lives in the report package itself, covering everything it answers about a set of batches:

- **`internal/report/summary.go` — `Summary.Observe`** (feeds `Aggregate` / `--summary`): skips `!record.Valid` before incrementing counts or adding to totals. Invalid records no longer inflate per-metric count/total lines.
- **`internal/report/aggregate.go` — `Distinct`** (feeds `--names-only`): skips `!record.Valid` before recording a name, so invalid records can't inflate the distinct-name count either.

The legacy package was untouched — it's explicitly not wired into the service and takes no `api.Record`s. No existing tests were modified; the existing `TestSummaryCountsPerName` (all-valid records) still passes.[tokens] prompt=29626 completion=275 cached=29184
